subject.title: refactor(retry): consolidate abort-safe ClawHub and memory retries

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled retry refactor be accepted after final exact-head CI and owner review of the shared retry-contract substitution?
rationale: The patch crosses a core retry helper and a bundled plugin’s cancellation/lease boundary; repository policy keeps protected maintainer-labeled items out of automated cleanup decisions.

options.title: Approve after final checks
options.body: Accept the consolidation if final exact-head CI is green and the owner confirms the preserved response, retry-cap, and abort-reason contracts.

options.title: Request a narrower split
options.body: Separate the ClawHub and Memory Core portions if maintainers want independent rollout or review ownership for the two retry contracts.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Keep existing specialized loops if shared-helper semantics cannot be shown to match either caller’s full production contract.

recommendation.title: Approve after final checks
recommendation.body: Accept the consolidation if final exact-head CI is green and the owner confirms the preserved response, retry-cap, and abort-reason contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review context identifies steipete as the contributor with direct knowledge of the proposed retry consolidation; broader ownership history could not be verified in the read-only environment.
